text: Four deliverables aren't a portfolio piece yet. A portfolio piece is the narrative connecting them — a problem, how you made sure it worked, how you'd know if it stopped, and what you'd do about it.
The feature, one sentence. The eval — a hard case. The monitoring — one chart. The incident plan — the failure mode and its trigger. The model card — the caveat you're most honest about.
Notice what's not there: a claim the system is perfect. The strongest signal is showing a case that failed and what you changed because of it.
There's a real difference between 'this has a limitation' and 'this doesn't work.' Naming the specific weakness and the control that catches it is a stronger statement than hiding it.

This course closes five chapters of production AI discipline — risks, evals, monitoring, governance, and one real pipeline you built yourself. Next in this path: AI Engineering Capstones, where that discipline applies at full scale.
